value.rationale: The joint critical window is motivated by the response of a symmetry-breaking interacting-voter population to both total zealotry and an asymmetry field. It fixes four linked scales: √N total-population detuning, N^(1/4) absolute imbalance, N^(3/4) magnetization fluctuations, and √N directional switching times. The exact non-Gaussian law and two hitting-time quadratures supply observables for critical data collapse beyond symmetric variance scaling. This is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a trivial restatement of an existing scalar invariant.
